mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary policy regime that increases discount rates for equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the mean 20-day return in such instances is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, which suppresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.5%, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential investment (HOUST) above 1950 thousand units signals strong household demand and confidence, which drives corporate revenue expectations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1950, or the mean return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110.0 indicates weakening manufacturing activity and broadening economic slowdown, which triggers risk-off sentiment and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 110.0, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both personal consumption (GDPC1) and residential investment (HOUST) signals broad-based demand strength, which increases corporate earnings visibility and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 50% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST are rising, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPIAUCSL above 199.5 and FEDFUNDS above 4.7% signals persistent inflation and a restrictive monetary policy, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both CPIAUCSL > 199.5 and FEDFUNDS > 4.7%, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 135,000 and a decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.7% signals a labor market that is both expanding and tightening, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 135000 and UNRATE < 4.7, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) above 362,000 million dollars, combined with rising industrial production (INDPRO), signals strong underlying demand and supply-side resilience, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS > 362000 and INDPRO is rising, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
